messages:
Maya: Quick thread - enterprise asks for an onboarding SLA + compatibility shim for a niche translate model family. They want a deterministic migration window, bench pass criteria, and a documented rollback path. Thoughts?
Zoe: We can offer a short-term compatibility shim that rewrites inputs/outputs to match the previous model behavior for up to 30 days. Longer retention needs a reserved slot.
Harish: Bench needs to be explicit: p95 latency @512 tokens <= 320ms on reserved pool; embedding cosine >= 0.95 for key vectors; fail if quality delta > 1% on the curated prompt set. Also require safety checks.
Eng-Infra: Fragmentation risk flagged - if we grant reserved slots per-customer we lose packing. Suggest: "shim-lite" (30d, best-effort Hosted), "shim-reserved" (60-120d, billed, reserved pool), or Dedicated. Need infra to quantify cost per slot.
contracts-bot: Draft clause suggestion: \"Provider will offer a compatibility shim during the Retention Term. Provider will provide migration notice >= 10 business days and a 72-hour rollback window post-migration if Customer test-suite fails the agreed acceptance criteria.\"
Maya: Proposal from product: ship shim-lite as a free opt-in for small customers (30d), ship shim-reserved as paid with a guaranteed p95 cap + audit logs + migration notice. Auto-unpin at term unless customer renews.
Zoe: Launch gates: 1) bench suite & acceptance tests defined and run; 2) infra cost delta & reserved slot sizing approved; 3) legal addendum for shim + migration veto; 4) telemetry/regression alerts live; 5) 2 canaries (1 customer + 1 internal) or 3 customer canaries.
Harish: Bench matrix to include: perf (p50/p95), quality (BLEU/ROUGE or task-specific metric), embedding stability (cosine), safety checks. Also define a small sample of 250 critical prompts for veto checks.
Eng-Infra: Action items: provide cost estimate for a single reserved shim slot (including quantization variance), recommend min commitment. ETA 4 business days.
Maya: Product actions: draft shim product page, pricing tiers, and renewal workflow. ETA EOW.
contracts-bot: Recommend adding: customer must run canary traffic and upload canary results; provider will share regression reports.
Zoe: Canary config example for shim-reserved:
```
canary_config:
  mode: reserved
  duration_days: 14
  traffic_pct: 5
  acceptance_tests: ["perf", "quality", "safety"]
```
Harish: Also recommend an "interop mode" where new model is served alongside older model for 14 days with result diff logging to catch silent drift.
Maya: Timeline: sync next Thursday after infra posts slot cost. If infra shows high fragmentation risk, fallback to Reserved-only for >30d retention.
Eng-Infra: ack. We'll post numbers in the infra sheet and tag this thread.
Maya: Thanks all 44d - will file spec and legal ask once numbers are in.
